categories.name: Fades
categories.note: Opacity does the work, sometimes with a little scale or blur

categories.name: Slides
categories.note: Views move along an axis, like going forward and back

categories.name: Scale & 3D
categories.note: Views grow, shrink or turn over

categories.name: Reveals
categories.note: A mask or a panel uncovers the next view

categories.name: Choreography
categories.note: Parts of a view move, resize or arrive in sequence

transitions.name: Crossfade
transitions.aka: Fade, dissolve, cross-dissolve
transitions.desc: The old view fades out while the new one fades in over it. The default for page changes, and what the View Transitions API does when you add nothing else.
transitions.prompt: crossfade between routes, 200ms ease-out, using the View Transitions API

transitions.name: Fade through
transitions.aka: Sequential fade, fade out then in
transitions.desc: The old view fades out first, then the new one fades in while scaling up slightly. Use it when the two views aren't related, like switching tabs in a bottom bar.
transitions.prompt: fade-through transition: old view fades out, then new view fades in and scales from 92% to 100%

transitions.name: Blur fade
transitions.aka: Blur in, defocus transition
transitions.desc: Views blur as they fade, so the change feels soft, like a camera refocusing. Popular on landing pages and for text that swaps in place.
transitions.prompt: blur fade transition, outgoing view blurs to 8px and fades, incoming view sharpens from blur as it fades in

transitions.name: Fade up
transitions.aka: Slide-up fade, fade in up, rise in
transitions.desc: The new view fades in while rising a short distance into place. The most common entrance on the web, for sections, cards and toasts.
transitions.prompt: fade up entrance: content fades in while moving up 12px, 300ms ease-out

transitions.name: Push
transitions.aka: Slide, page slide, carousel slide
transitions.desc: The new view slides in from the side and pushes the old one out. Both move together. Used for carousels, onboarding steps and wizards.
transitions.prompt: push slide transition, new page slides in from the right and pushes the old page out to the left

transitions.name: Slide over
transitions.aka: Cover, stack navigation, iOS push
transitions.desc: The new view slides over the old one, which shifts back a little and dims. Reads as moving deeper into a stack, like opening a detail screen on a phone.
transitions.how: transform + shadow on the incoming view, dim the outgoing view
transitions.prompt: iOS-style stack navigation: new screen slides over from the right with a shadow, previous screen shifts left 30% and dims

transitions.name: Uncover
transitions.aka: Reveal slide, slide away, pop navigation
transitions.desc: The old view slides off to the side and reveals the new one already waiting underneath. The reverse of slide over, so it reads as going back.
transitions.how: transform on the outgoing view only, z-index above the incoming view
transitions.prompt: uncover transition: the current page slides out to the right with a shadow, revealing the previous page underneath

transitions.name: Shared axis
transitions.aka: Slide and fade, directional fade
transitions.desc: Both views shift a short distance in the same direction while they fade. Gentler than a full push, and the direction still tells you forward from back.
transitions.prompt: shared axis X transition: outgoing view slides 15% left and fades out, incoming view slides in from 15% right and fades in

transitions.name: Sheet
transitions.aka: Modal present, slide up, card stack
transitions.desc: The new view slides up from the bottom as a card while the page behind shrinks a little and dims. How iOS presents modals, and how many mobile web apps open details.
transitions.how: translateY on the sheet, scale + dim on the page behind
transitions.prompt: sheet presentation: new view slides up from the bottom with rounded top corners, the page behind scales to 92% and dims

transitions.name: Zoom
transitions.aka: Scale transition, zoom in, scale and fade
transitions.desc: The old view grows and fades away while the new one scales up into place. Feels like stepping into the content.
transitions.prompt: zoom transition, old view scales up to 115% and fades out while the new view scales from 85% to 100% and fades in

transitions.name: Pop
transitions.aka: Scale in, dialog open, zoom in fade
transitions.desc: A dialog scales up from slightly smaller while it fades in, and the page behind dims. The standard enter animation for modals and dialogs.
transitions.how: scale(0.95) + opacity on the dialog, backdrop fade
transitions.prompt: dialog pop-in: scales from 95% to 100% and fades in over 150ms, backdrop fades to 50% black

transitions.name: Origin-aware scale
transitions.aka: Transform origin, grow from trigger, popover open
transitions.desc: A menu or popover grows out of the button that opened it, instead of from its own center. Small, but it tells you where the panel came from.
transitions.how: transform-origin set to the trigger side + scale
transitions.prompt: popover opens with an origin-aware scale from the trigger corner, scale 0.6 to 1 with fade, transform-origin top right

transitions.name: Flip
transitions.aka: Card flip, 3D flip, rotate Y
transitions.desc: The view turns over like a card to show its back. Used for flashcards, pricing toggles and front/back details.
transitions.prompt: 3D card flip on the Y axis with perspective, the back face is hidden until it turns past 90 degrees

transitions.name: Cube
transitions.aka: 3D cube, cube rotate, stories transition
transitions.desc: The two views are faces of a cube that turns to show the next face. Known from story viewers and image carousels.
transitions.how: rotateY + translateX with transform-origin on the shared edge, perspective
transitions.prompt: 3D cube transition between slides, the cube rotates left to show the next face, with perspective

transitions.name: Circle reveal
transitions.aka: Iris, radial reveal, theme toggle reveal
transitions.desc: The new view grows out of a circle that starts at one point, often the button that was clicked. The classic dark-mode toggle effect.
transitions.prompt: circular clip-path reveal that expands from the clicked button, using the View Transitions API

transitions.name: Wipe
transitions.aka: Linear wipe, clip reveal, edge wipe
transitions.desc: A straight edge sweeps across and replaces the old view with the new one. Neither view moves; only the edge does.
transitions.prompt: linear wipe transition from left to right using clip-path inset

transitions.name: Soft wipe
transitions.aka: Feathered wipe, gradient wipe, mask wipe
transitions.desc: Like a wipe, but the edge is a soft gradient, so the new view melts in from one side instead of being cut in.
transitions.how: mask-image: linear-gradient() with an animated stop
transitions.prompt: soft gradient mask wipe from left to right, 20% feathered edge, using mask-image

transitions.name: Curtain
transitions.aka: Overlay wipe, panel sweep, page cover
transitions.desc: A solid panel sweeps in to cover the page, the content swaps while it's hidden, then the panel sweeps away. Common on agency and portfolio sites.
transitions.how: an overlay element with transform, swap content at full cover
transitions.prompt: curtain page transition: a solid brand-colored panel sweeps in from the left, the page swaps behind it, then the panel exits to the right

transitions.name: Column wipe
transitions.aka: Staggered panels, stripe curtain, bar transition
transitions.desc: Several vertical panels rise one after another to cover the page, the content swaps, then they leave. A favorite on agency and portfolio sites.
transitions.how: several overlay panels with staggered transform delays
transitions.prompt: page transition with five vertical panels that rise in a stagger to cover the screen, then exit upward to reveal the new page

transitions.name: Split
transitions.aka: Doors, barn doors, split reveal
transitions.desc: The old view splits down the middle and both halves slide apart like doors, revealing the new view behind.
transitions.how: two clipped copies of the outgoing view, translateX in opposite directions
transitions.prompt: split doors transition: the current page splits vertically down the middle and both halves slide apart to reveal the next page

transitions.name: Tile reveal
transitions.aka: Grid transition, pixel transition, mosaic
transitions.desc: A grid of tiles pops in diagonally to cover the page, then pops away to show the new one. Feels digital and playful.
transitions.how: a grid of overlay tiles with scale and staggered delays
transitions.prompt: tile grid page transition: square tiles scale in diagonally from the top left to cover the page, then scale out to reveal the next page

transitions.name: Shape reveal
transitions.aka: Mask reveal, logo mask, shape transition
transitions.desc: The new view shows through a shape that grows until it fills the screen. Any shape works: a diamond, a logo or a letter.
transitions.prompt: diamond shape mask reveal that grows from the center until it covers the page

transitions.name: Shared element
transitions.aka: Container transform, hero transition, morph, magic move
transitions.desc: One element, like a card's image, travels and resizes into its place on the next view, while everything else fades. The eye follows it, so the two views feel connected.
transitions.prompt: shared element transition: the card thumbnail morphs into the detail page hero image using view-transition-name, other content crossfades

transitions.name: Stagger
transitions.aka: Cascade, sequenced entrance, staggered fade-in
transitions.desc: The new view's parts arrive one after another instead of all at once, each with a small delay. Guides the eye down the page.
transitions.prompt: staggered entrance, list items fade in and rise 8px one after another with a 60ms delay between each

transitions.name: Expand
transitions.aka: Accordion, collapse, height animation
transitions.desc: A row grows taller to show more detail, and everything below it moves down to make room. Used for accordions, FAQs and expandable rows.
transitions.prompt: smooth expand and collapse: the row grows to show its details and the rows below slide down, animate grid-template-rows from 0fr to 1fr

transitions.name: Reorder
transitions.aka: Layout animation, FLIP, list shuffle
transitions.desc: When items change order, each one glides to its new spot instead of jumping. Used for sortable lists, filters and drag and drop.
transitions.how: FLIP technique, Motion layout, view-transition-name per item
transitions.prompt: animate list reordering with FLIP so each item glides to its new position, 250ms ease-in-out
